# PayVision

> PayVision is a merchant payment gateway platform providing PayIn (UPI/card collection) and Payout (bank transfer) services. It offers a merchant portal for transaction management, wallet operations, commission tracking, and API integration.

PayVision is a B2B payment infrastructure platform. Merchants integrate via REST API to accept payments and initiate payouts. The admin console manages merchant onboarding, wallet funding, commissions, and settlement reporting.

## Platform

- [Dashboard](http://187.127.162.29/): Real-time PayIn/Payout stats, 7-day transaction chart, recent transactions, merchant balance overview
- [Login](http://187.127.162.29/login): JWT-based authentication with rate limiting (5 attempts, 15-min lock), remember-me (30 days), auto-logout on 30-min inactivity

## Merchant Management (Admin)

- [New Registration](http://187.127.162.29/merchants/new-registration): Onboard merchants — business name, contact, PAN, Aadhaar, GST, IFSC, callback URLs
- [Active Merchants](http://187.127.162.29/merchants/active): List active merchants with API key/secret copy
- [Pending Merchants](http://187.127.162.29/merchants/pending): Review and approve pending merchant applications
- [New Connection](http://187.127.162.29/merchants/new-connection): Recently connected merchants

## Wallet & Finance

- [PG (PayIn) Wallet](http://187.127.162.29/wallet/payin): Fund merchant PayIn wallets, view history
- [Payout Wallet](http://187.127.162.29/wallet/payout): Fund merchant Payout wallets, initiate transfers, view history
- [Client Wallet](http://187.127.162.29/wallet): Merchant-facing wallet view — PayIn and Payout balances

## Commission

- [PG Commission](http://187.127.162.29/commission/pg): Set PayIn commission rates per merchant
- [Payout Commission](http://187.127.162.29/commission/payout): Set Payout commission rates per merchant

## Reports

- [PayIn Report](http://187.127.162.29/reports): Filter PayIn transactions by date, merchant, status; export
- [Payout Report](http://187.127.162.29/reports/payout): Filter Payout transactions; status check integration
- [Security Amount Report](http://187.127.162.29/reports/security-amount): View security deposits per merchant

## Account & Settings

- [Profile](http://187.127.162.29/profile): Update name, email, phone
- [Change Password](http://187.127.162.29/profile/change-password): Password update with strength validation
- [Change TPIN](http://187.127.162.29/profile/change-tpin): 6-digit transaction PIN management
- [API Settings](http://187.127.162.29/api-settings): Admin — set merchant callback URLs, IP whitelist (Admin only)
- [API Credentials](http://187.127.162.29/api-credentials): Merchant — view own API key and secret
- [Manage Employees](http://187.127.162.29/employees): Create and manage admin/staff accounts

## API Reference

- [API Documentation](http://187.127.162.29/api-docs): Full REST API docs — PayIn create-order, status-check, Payout pay-order, status-check, webhook specs
- [PayIn Create Order](http://187.127.162.29/api/v1/payin/create-order): POST — initiate a payment collection
- [PayIn Status Check](http://187.127.162.29/api/v1/payin/status-check): POST — query PayIn transaction status
- [Payout Pay Order](http://187.127.162.29/api/v1/payout/create-order): POST — initiate a bank transfer
- [Payout Status Check](http://187.127.162.29/api/v1/payout/status-check): POST — query Payout transaction status
- [Auth Token](http://187.127.162.29/api/v1/openmoney/auth/client-token): POST — obtain bearer token for API calls
